One-time: point at the folder this extension was loaded from, so the updater may write there. Nothing is written outside it, ever.

2 Update

Fetches the new version's files from the repo and writes them into your install folder. It does not delete anything and does not restart the extension — you press ↻ on chrome://extensions afterwards, and this page tells you when.

Repair rewrites every current file — use it if the extension misbehaves or an update was interrupted. It never needs a newer version to exist.

Why was update.js refused? — run a test

Four writes into a scratch folder you pick — never your install folder, nothing here is installed. Two names × two contents, so the answer separates "it is the filename" from "it is what is inside the file". Delete the folder afterwards.
